name: ihris5
title: iHRIS 5
description: iHRIS 5, the FHIR-based rewrite, on GitHub: the application (backend, frontend, FHIR Implementation Guide in FSH) and its technical documentation, each pinned at a commit. Its IG (`ig/`) is built from that pinned source with fhir-harness and published only on gh-pages, at /ihris/ihris5/.
_source_comment: The iHRIS 5 IG this subgraph BUILDS, in core's own git-source shape (bean bamf): iHRIS/iHRIS at the commit `upstream` pins, the IG at `ig/`. Owner, 2026-10-09: 'treat more like a remote mount, except there is no remote index.config.json. rather i want litlfred/ihris to say that ihris-5 is a named subgraph using fhir-harness'. So it is mounted like one (pinned, verified, git-ignored at ihris5-source/, never committed) by src/tools/mount_ihris5.sh, which reads THIS field, and the IG is built by fhir-harness's AST pipeline (litlfred/fhir-ig-publisher's ast-export, then just-the-docs) and published only on gh-pages, at /ihris/ihris5/ (.github/workflows/ihris5-ig.yml). The two IGs under ihris-backend/ihris-backend-site/ are not built yet.
